plan.notes: Sample degree program from the JCCC 2026-27 catalog. Requires minimum 60 credit hours: 34 hrs Kansas Systemwide General Education (SGE) + 26 hrs electives. Students must complete an approved cultural diversity course. Open electives are non-developmental courses meeting degree requirements; students should consult a JCCC counselor.
